display.outputDescription: accept/reject of the relation over the typed statement; no ledger result
display.assumptions: BLAKE2b-256 collision resistance; the template fixes the decoding path to output 1; Groth16 knowledge soundness as MCP-EXE-01. Inclusion of B in any chain is not part of this relation.
display.notEstablished: Inclusion on any chain; Preprod membership (network label asserted, body key 15 absent); phase-2 validity (is_valid and witnesses outside the txid); signer; output existence or unspentness; finality; any other template shape; that a circuit enforces each binding constraint of this statement schema.
